<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the forward sulfonamide formation: an aromatic amine (primary amine) reacts with a sulfonyl chloride (acyl chloride) to give a sulfonamide. The forward reaction breaks an acyl‑chloride (S‑Cl) bond and a primary‑amine N‑H bond, and forms a sulfonamide (N‑S) bond. Using the allowed functional‑group names, we query the template catalog with broken groups “acyl chloride” and “primary amines”, and formed group “sulfonamides”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride", "primary amines"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
